text: SEED-V15-01 — The Third-Row Blight. TYPE: resource. ANCHORS: Ilona Brandt, Lenka. TRIGGER: Ilona's message in [01]. HOOK: the mushroom hall on the third row has blight; may she burn it? STAKES: visible — food stock; hidden — whether the blight is natural. BRANCHES: burn it all; burn part and quarantine; investigate first (risk spread). LINKS: C-ILONA, [21], [22].
